answer.answer: Ujjwala 2.0 provides special facility to migrant households [E03]. The predecessor Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), launched in May 2016, established a transition from traditional cooking fuels such as firewood, coal, and cow-dung cakes to clean cooking fuel like LPG [E01], making LPG available to rural and deprived households [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Ujjwala 2.0 provides special facility to migrant households
The predecessor PMUY established a transition from traditional cooking fuels to clean cooking fuel like LPG
PMUY made LPG available to rural and deprived households
